Breadcrumb

Breadcrumbs show the current page's location within a navigational hierarchy, helping users understand where they are and navigate back to parent pages.

Basic Breadcrumb

A simple breadcrumb with clickable links and a current page indicator.

  1. Home
  2. Products
  3. Electronics
  4. Headphones
HTML
<nav class="zak-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <ol class="zak-breadcrumb-list">
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item"><a href="#">Home</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item"><a href="#">Products</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item"><a href="#">Electronics</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item" aria-current="page">Headphones</li>
    </ol>
</nav>

Breadcrumb with Icons

Add icons to breadcrumb items for visual context.

  1. Home
  2. Projects
  3. Redesign
HTML
<li class="zak-breadcrumb-item">
    <a href="#">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
        Home
    </a>
</li>

Chevron separator

<!-- Slash (default) -->

Responsive Breadcrumb

Breadcrumbs collapse middle items on smaller screens with an ellipsis.

  1. Home
  2. Company
  3. ...
  4. Department
  5. Team
  6. Project Settings
HTML
<nav class="zak-breadcrumb zak-breadcrumb-responsive">
    <ol class="zak-breadcrumb-list">
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item"><a href="#">Home</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item" style="display: none;"><a href="#">Company</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item"><a href="#">...</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item"><a href="#">Department</a></li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item" aria-current="page">Project Settings</li>
    </ol>
</nav>

CSS Classes

Breadcrumb styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Breadcrumb Container */
.zak-breadcrumb                    /* Base breadcrumb */
.zak-breadcrumb-chevron            /* Chevron separators */
.zak-breadcrumb-arrow              /* Arrow separators */
.zak-breadcrumb-responsive         /* Responsive collapse */

/* Breadcrumb Parts */
.zak-breadcrumb-list               /* Ordered list container */
.zak-breadcrumb-item               /* List item */

/* States */
.zak-breadcrumb-item a             /* Clickable link */
.zak-breadcrumb-item[aria-current] /* Current page (no link) */

JavaScript

Handle responsive breadcrumb collapse with JavaScript.

HTML
// Responsive breadcrumb: collapse middle items on small screens
function updateBreadcrumb() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.zak-breadcrumb-responsive .zak-breadcrumb-list').forEach(list => {
        const items = list.querySelectorAll('.zak-breadcrumb-item');
        const isSmall = window.innerWidth < 640;
        items.forEach((item, i) => {
            if (i > 0 && i < items.length - 2) {
                item.style.display = isSmall ? 'none' : '';
            }
        });
        // Show/hide ellipsis
        const ellipsis = list.querySelector('.zak-breadcrumb-ellipsis');
        if (ellipsis) {
            ellipsis.style.display = isSmall ? '' : 'none';
        }
    });
}

window.addEventListener('resize', updateBreadcrumb);
updateBreadcrumb();

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using breadcrumbs.

  • Use <nav> with aria-label="Breadcrumb" to identify the navigation.
  • Use an ordered list <ol> to convey the hierarchical structure.
  • Mark the current page with aria-current="page".
  • Don't separate the <ol> from the <nav> with aria-labelledby or similar.
  • Separators should be hidden from screen readers with aria-hidden="true".
  • Ensure link text is descriptive enough to be meaningful out of context.
HTML
<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
    <ol class="zak-breadcrumb-list">
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item">
            <a href="#">Home</a>
        </li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item">
            <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
            <a href="#">Products</a>
        </li>
        <li class="zak-breadcrumb-item">
            <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
            <span aria-current="page">Headphones</span>
        </li>
    </ol>
</nav>
